modules.hardware: Detect your Deck model and provide device support used by other setup features.
modules.gaming: Choose launchers for games from stores outside Steam, plus optional compatibility tools.
modules.controller: Add Steam Input templates and profiles to make desktop apps and games easier to control.
modules.decky: Add plugins to Game Mode for artwork, useful controls and appearance changes. Choose plugins separately.
modules.library: Find broken or duplicate Steam shortcuts and repair your library when it needs cleanup.
modules.emulation: Set up EmuDeck to organize and play your own retro games. Choose emulators in its setup wizard.
modules.android: Run Android apps through Waydroid. Choose this if you need apps unavailable on SteamOS.
modules.terminal: Choose a terminal, text editor or command-line helpers to suit how you work.
modules.dev: Choose a coding assistant or an isolated development container for project tools.
modules.workspace: Open Notion, ChatGPT or Claude in dedicated windows instead of keeping them in browser tabs.
modules.ai-workspace: Use OpenCode for coding sessions that run on demand. Local engine and model downloads are optional.
modules.utilities: Choose browsers, chat apps, editors and media players for everyday Desktop Mode use.
modules.storage: Organize Steam games and emulation files across drives or a microSD card.
modules.remote: Play from your PC or PlayStation, or connect to your devices when away from home.
modules.backup: Back up saves and workstation settings so you can recover after a reset or storage failure.
modules.media: Add individual streaming services to Game Mode so you can watch without switching to the desktop.

apps.flatseal: Adjust Flatpak app permissions when an app needs access to your files or devices.
apps.zen: Use a dedicated desktop browser for browsing, research and everyday web apps.
apps.vscode: Edit code with extensions and project tools. Useful if you already work in VS Code.
apps.zed: Use a focused code editor for project work when you want an alternative to VS Code.
apps.vlc: Play local video and audio files without needing a streaming service.
apps.plex: Watch media from your Plex library. Requires access to a Plex server and your account.
apps.spotify: Listen to music and podcasts while working. Sign in with your Spotify account.
apps.discord: Join community text and voice chats, or keep in touch with friends while gaming.
apps.slack: Use team channels and work messages on the Deck. Sign in to your Slack workspace.
apps.parsec: Connect to a Windows or Mac computer for remote play or work. Requires a Parsec account; the Deck joins sessions as a client.
apps.whatsapp: Message your WhatsApp contacts through Whatsie, a third-party web client. Link it to your WhatsApp account using your phone.
apps.telegram: Keep up with Telegram chats, groups and shared files on the Deck. Sign in to your Telegram account to sync conversations.

components.ghostty: Use a separate terminal app for command-line work while keeping Konsole available.
components.tmux: Keep terminal sessions alive when you disconnect, and arrange several shells in panes.
components.nvim: Edit text and code inside the terminal. Useful if you prefer keyboard-driven editing.
components.opencode: Work with an AI coding client in the terminal. Connect a provider or use the optional local engine.
components.oh-my-posh: Show folder, Git and command status in a customizable prompt. Enable Shell helpers to activate it.
components.starship: Use an alternative prompt with project and Git context. Enable Shell helpers to activate it.
components.zoxide: Jump to folders you use often without typing their full paths. Shell helpers enable its shortcuts.
components.fzf: Find files and command history by typing part of a name. Shell helpers enable keyboard shortcuts.
components.eza: Get richer directory listings with Git status and icons. Shell helpers add convenient commands.
components.bat: Read files with syntax highlighting in the terminal. Useful for quickly inspecting source code.
components.fastfetch: See Deck specs, RAM, storage, battery and session details in the Bubble Gum Rave theme with Sharingan artwork. Add Shell helpers for the ff shortcut.
components.fonts: Add JetBrains Mono with extra symbols so terminal prompts and file icons display clearly.
components.shell: Enable convenient Bash aliases and integrations for your selected tools. Keeps Bash as your shell.
components.konsole: Apply the Bubble Gum Rave colors and profile to Konsole if you want a customized terminal appearance.
components.ollama: Run supported AI models locally instead of sending requests to a cloud provider. No service starts at login.
components.model: Download a small coding model for local AI sessions. Requires Ollama; uses disk space and RAM while running.
components.codex: Use a standalone coding agent to work on projects from the terminal. Provider sign-in is separate.
components.distrobox: Keep project dependencies in a deck-dev container. Requires Distrobox and Podman already available.
components.moonlight: Stream games from a Sunshine-equipped PC to your Deck. Pair with your PC after installation.
components.chiaki: Play your PS4 or PS5 remotely on the Deck. Requires a console and registration during setup.
components.tailscale: Reach your own devices over a private network when away from home. Adds a persistent service and needs sign-in.
components.notion: Keep notes and project pages in a dedicated Notion window. Uses Chrome and your Notion account.
components.chatgpt: Open ChatGPT in its own window for questions and writing. Uses Chrome; account access remains separate.
components.claude: Open Claude in its own window for writing and assistance. Uses Chrome; account access remains separate.
components.netflix: Open Netflix directly from Game Mode. Uses Chrome and requires your own service access.
components.hulu: Open Hulu directly from Game Mode. Uses Chrome and requires your own service access.
components.crunchyroll: Open Crunchyroll directly from Game Mode for anime and other available shows. Uses Chrome and your account.
components.prime-video: Open Prime Video directly from Game Mode. Uses Chrome and requires your own service access.
components.keeper: Use KeeperFill to fill saved logins in Chrome web apps. Requires Chrome and your Keeper account.

launchers.heroic: Install and manage Epic, GOG and Amazon games in one launcher, then add games to Steam.
launchers.battlenet: Install Blizzard games such as WoW or Diablo. Runs targeted Battle.net setup and requires sign-in.
launchers.protonplus: Manage extra compatibility-tool versions when a particular game needs one.
launchers.nonsteamlaunchers: Keep a manual installer available for additional game stores. Choose vendors in its own setup.

plugins.SDH-CssLoader: Customize Game Mode with themes and visual components. Choose its components separately after selecting this plugin.
plugins.decky-steamgriddb: Add covers, backgrounds and icons to games and non-Steam shortcuts so your library is easier to recognize.
plugins.protondb-decky: See community compatibility information on game pages before deciding how to run a game.
plugins.PowerTools: Tune specific games or emulators when they need it. This setup does not apply global performance changes.
plugins.hltb-for-deck: See estimated game lengths on game pages when choosing what to play next.
plugins.decky-autoflatpaks: See Flatpak update information in Game Mode. This setup does not enable unattended updates.
plugins.Bluetooth: Access Bluetooth controls from Game Mode when connecting headphones or other devices.
plugins.Emuchievements: See RetroAchievements information for emulated games if you use that achievement service.
plugins.decky-nonsteam-badges: Make non-Steam library entries easier to identify at a glance.
plugins.SDH-AnimationChanger: Personalize startup and suspend animations when you want a different look.
plugins.SDH-AudioLoader: Customize interface sounds if you want the Deck to sound different from the default.
plugins.decky-game-settings: Read community performance and compatibility reports when tuning a game. Settings are not applied automatically.
plugins.EmuDecky: Access EmuDeck shortcuts, settings and emulator maintenance from Game Mode.
plugins.ControllerTools: Add controller utilities in Game Mode if you frequently use external controllers.
plugins.SDH-GameThemeMusic: Play game-related theme music on game pages to personalize browsing your library.
plugins.MagicPodsDecky: See battery information and supported controls for compatible Bluetooth earbuds.
plugins.TabMaster: Customize library tabs and filters to make a large game collection easier to browse.
plugins.moondeck: Launch streamed PC games with tighter Moonlight integration. Requires MoonDeck Buddy on the PC.
plugins.Deck-Shelves: Add more ways to organize your home screen and library when standard collections are not enough.
plugins.tailscale-control: Control an existing Tailscale service from the Quick Access Menu. Install Tailscale separately if needed.
plugins.decky-storage-cleaner: Inspect storage that could be cleaned up. Review files yourself; this setup never auto-deletes them.
plugins.vibrantDeck: Adjust color saturation beyond the normal controls. Usually unnecessary if you like the OLED defaults.
plugins.Fantastic: Adjust fan behavior for specific needs. Prefer the default fan curve unless you have a measured reason to change it.
plugins.decky-autosuspend: Add stricter low-battery or idle suspension behavior if the default behavior does not suit you.
plugins.steam-deck-battery-tracker: Track battery history and power statistics to understand usage over time.
plugins.SDH-PauseGames: Pause and resume game processes while multitasking. Some games may not tolerate forced suspension.
plugins.VolumeMixer-decky: Adjust volume separately for running apps from Game Mode.
plugins.BetterKeyboard: Customize on-screen keyboard behavior if you often type without a physical keyboard.

css.Chromahon (Steam Menu): Customize the STEAM-button side menu so it matches your chosen appearance.
css.Chromahon (Input Controls): Style controller button hints and footer controls for a more consistent interface.
css.Chromahon (Context Menus): Style right-click and Options menus so popups match the rest of your setup.
css.Chromahon (QAM): Customize the … Quick Access Menu to match your Game Mode appearance.
css.Round: Round the corners of cards and panels if you prefer a softer interface.
css.Full Screen Menus: Make the Steam and Quick Access menus taller for a more spacious layout.
css.Colored Keyboard: Apply matching colors to the on-screen keyboard without changing its layout.
css.Centered Game Text: Center game titles on the home screen if you prefer a balanced layout.
css.DellyVolume: Give the volume overlay a cleaner, more compact appearance.
css.Better Game Icons: Refine the small icons shown in your library, including non-Steam entries.
css.Better Game Badges: Refine game badges for a more consistent look alongside compatibility information.
css.Top Bar Transparency: Make the top bar transparent so more of the background artwork shows through.
css.Better Blur: Add background blur behind interface panels for a glass-like appearance.
css.Better Achievements: Restyle achievement sections on game pages without changing navigation.
css.Game Cover Reflections: Add decorative reflections below recent-game covers.
css.Percentages: Show numeric volume and brightness values so you can set levels more precisely.
css.No Game Count: Hide collection game counts if you prefer a less cluttered library.
css.Art Hero: Give game artwork more space on the home screen. Changes the home-screen layout.
css.Clean Gameview: Simplify game-detail pages. Steam updates may affect this layout customization.
css.Clean Game Launch: Simplify the screen shown when starting a game for a cleaner transition.
css.Focus Highlight Color: Color the focused selection border so your current controller selection stands out.
css.Hero Zoom Eradication: Reduce hero-art zoom behavior if you prefer a steadier background.
css.No Home Edge Fade: Remove the home-screen edge fade to show more of your artwork.
css.Mini Carousel: Shrink recent-game cards to leave more space for the background art.
css.Gradient Top Bar: Use a gradient top bar as an alternative to a transparent one.
css.Game Cover Shine Animation: Add an animated shine to game covers if you want extra visual motion.
css.Tilted Home: Give the home screen a tilted layout. May conflict with other home-screen layout themes.
css.DellyFooter: Use a more minimal footer for controller button hints.
css.Static Background: Use a fixed background image in Game Mode if you prefer your own wallpaper.
css.Faster Transition Animations: Shorten interface transitions if you prefer quicker menu movement.
